svg.title: XII. The Hanged Man: nvf
svg.desc: XII. The Hanged Man, reversed. Nix. a highly extensible and distro agnostic configuration framework for Neovim using Nix. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), Dante falls through compassion. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 93. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
